translations.web: Let his own eyes see his destruction. Let him drink of the wrath of the Almighty.
translations.bsb: Let his eyes see his own destruction; let him drink for himself the wrath of the Almighty.
translations.kjv: His eyes shall see his destruction, and he shall drink of the wrath of the Almighty.
translations.asv: Let his own eyes see his destruction, And let him drink of the wrath of the Almighty.
